name: The Strat Tower
note: The tower at the north end of the Strip, 350 m to its mast: a shaft on three legs, the pod of twelve storeys from 234 to 270 m with its glazed observation band, and the mast the rides climb.
source: OpenStreetMap way 135457469 'Stratosphere Tower', man_made=tower, height 350, 51 m across at its legs; the thrill rides' deck is way 503324066 (building:part), 25 m across at the top of the pod

name: Sphere
note: The sphere east of the Venetian, 157 m across and 112 m high, its middle 34 m above the ground.
source: OpenStreetMap way 976405284 'Sphere', height 112, shape=spherical_cutted, roof:shape=dome, opened 2023 (not in USA Structures: added from OpenStreetMap)

name: Allegiant Stadium
note: The closed stadium west of the Strip across Interstate 15: dark glass walls 69 m high round the bowl, open at the north-east where its doors look toward the Strip, under a light roof.
source: OpenStreetMap way 691478555 'Allegiant Stadium', leisure=stadium, height 69, building:colour black, roof:shape dome, capacity 65000; cut to USA Structures footprint 89367004 (Assembly, Indoor Arena)

name: Las Vegas Convention Center
note: The North, Central and South Halls as the one footprint USA Structures traces, 20 ha under a roof.
source: OpenStreetMap way 27925846 'Las Vegas Convention Center', amenity=conference_centre; USA Structures footprint 88997892, height 17.4

name: Las Vegas Convention Center West Hall
note: The West Hall of 2021, 494 m along the north side of the convention district.
source: USA Structures footprint 89391797, 51,068 m2, height 16.6, under OpenStreetMap relation 19515850 'Las Vegas Convention Center West Hall Expansion'

name: Luxor Las Vegas
note: The pyramid of dark glass at the south of the Strip, 182 m on a side and 108 m high, hollow round its atrium.
source: OpenStreetMap way 27858544 'Luxor Las Vegas', height 111, roof:shape pyramidal, building:colour black, building:material glass

name: High Roller
note: The observation wheel at the east end of the LINQ Promenade, 158 m across and 167 m high, standing north and south, over its boarding building.
source: OpenStreetMap way 402543930 'High Roller', attraction=big_wheel, height 167, its plan 131 by 30 m running north and south; the boarding building is way 1424252908

name: Eiffel Tower
note: The half-scale Eiffel Tower over Paris Las Vegas, 165 m, its restaurant deck at 30 m and its observation deck at 140 m.
source: OpenStreetMap way 27831699 'Eiffel Tower', man_made=tower, tower:construction lattice, height 165, building:levels 54
